posts.cooked:
The Galon-Ruta makes me think of Flekm from FuturePig, only made of metal.

I wonder…early 2021. They sounded very down at the start. I assumed that maybe a relative had died or something, but I wonder if it was like a quarterly financial report indicating they would be insolvent if they didn’t get bought. I never quite knew why Flat River happened, maybe this is the start of that.

They misspoke about the other houses around Diamond Manor; I believe they meant to say that each of those other houses “burned down, fell over, then sank into the swamp”. But the Diamond Manor stayed.

dpt:

Did they just casually mention that Nightmist can time travel, with the portal to Ancient Greece? Did we know Nightmist could do that?

My assumption is that it’s not an actual time portal, more like a mystical pocket realm where the centaurs and meliads etc still live, which used to be conjoined with ancient Greece in the same way that the Faerie realm overlaps the British isles.
